### Your Choice: Comparison or Contentment
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-24-2026.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 6:9
Points:
- Learning contentment requires ending the habit of comparing yourself to others.
- A key practice of contentment is admiring what others have without feeling the need to acquire it.
- You do not need to own something to enjoy it.
- Unchecked desires lead to coveting, which prevents genuine peace and contentment.

### Don’t Argue with a Sovereign God
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/dont-argue-with-a-sovereign-god
Passage: Ecclesiastes 6:10-12
Points:
- God is completely sovereign over human destiny, while mankind remains finite and limited.
- Arguing against God's sovereign will is an exercise in futility.
- Fighting God's hand prevents you from receiving the lessons He is trying to teach.
- Surrendering control to God lowers anxiety by shifting focus back to who sits on the throne.
